text: deepseek-openai-codex 是一个面向 DSH Web 配置的模型接入插件，通过 Cordis profile bundle 启用 DSH 内置 Pi AI 适配器中的 OpenAI Codex 路由。它为现有 llm-pi-ai 配置加入 openai-codex 提供方，让用户能够在 DSH 中选择该目录提供的模型。插件本身不实现模型适配器、OAuth 或传输逻辑，也不读取 API 密钥；授权由 DSH 提供的界面或命令完成。适合希望在兼容版本的 DSH 中启用原生 Codex 路由的用户。

deepseek-openai-codex enables DSH’s built-in OpenAI Codex route through a profile patch to llm-pi-ai. Users can select models from the installed Pi catalog. The package does not implement OAuth or model transport; authorization uses a surface provided by DSH.

deepseek-openai-codex 的功能「启用 Codex 路由」：把 openai-codex 加入 DSH 内置 llm-pi-ai 提供方配置。安装 bundle 后，用户可在 DSH 中选择该路由所提供的模型。
deepseek-openai-codex 的功能「检查 DSH 兼容接口」：兼容性脚本读取 DSH 版本、基础配置行、提供方配置类型、模型目录测试及原生授权接口，并在约定不匹配时停止检查。
deepseek-openai-codex 的功能「保留用户路由设置」：profile patch 激活 openai-codex；需要添加其他 Pi 提供方时，可在更高优先级的 DSH 用户设置中配置。
deepseek-openai-codex 使用前须知：该包只激活路由，不提供登录界面；若 DSH 没有授权入口，单独安装此包无法完成新登录。授权由宿主 DSH 承担。

deepseek-openai-codex README · deepseek-openai-codex：A configuration-only DeepSeek Harness profile bundle that activates the `openai-codex` route already supplied by DSH's built-in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter.

This package contains no model adapter, OAuth implementation, credential bridge, browser code, or OpenAI transport. DSH and its pinned Pi dependency own all of those behaviors. The package contributes one `cordis.patch.yml` layer:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      openai-codex: {}

deepseek-openai-codex README · Compatibility：Run the compatibility check against each new DSH source checkout before claiming support:

```powershell
pnpm check:dsh -- C:\path\to\deepseek-harness
```

Older DSH releases, including `0.1.0-rc.7`, are not supported by this branch. See [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md) for the exact policy and limitations.

deepseek-openai-codex README · Install：From GitHub:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:OpenCnid/deepseek-openai-codex
```

From a local checkout:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

Confirm that the bundle patched the existing provider row:

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

deepseek-openai-codex README · Install：The composed `llm-pi-ai` row should contain `providers.openai-codex` exactly once. Start DSH and select any model advertised for that route; model names and reasoning levels come from DSH's installed Pi catalog rather than this repository.
deepseek-openai-codex README · Sign in：Provider activation and authorization are separate. This bundle never reads, writes, copies, or prints an OAuth credential.

deepseek-openai-codex README · Sign in：Use an authorization surface supplied by your DSH installation to authorize the native record `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex`. If that DSH build exposes no authorization UI or command, this package alone cannot perform a fresh login; use a trusted DSH embedding surface that calls the registered authorization flow or upgrade to a build that supplies one. Do not place access or refresh tokens in `settings.yaml` or this repository.

deepseek-openai-codex README · Sign in：An existing native DSH credential remains usable after installing or removing this bundle. Credentials created by the retired `0.1.0-rc.7` adapter under `OPENAI_CODEX_OAUTH` are a different format and location; authorize again through DSH instead of copying them.

deepseek-openai-codex README · Add other Pi providers：This patch replaces the composition-level `llm-pi-ai` config rather than deep-merging it. Put additional routes in the higher-priority DSH user settings document:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    openai-codex: {}
    another-provider: {}

DSH validates each provider against the adapter and catalog installed in that DSH version.

deepseek-openai-codex README · Remove：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove deepseek-openai-codex
```

Removal drops only this configuration layer. It does not delete `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` credentials or alter user settings. Sign out through DSH when you also want the stored grant removed.

deepseek-openai-codex README · Development：```powershell
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm check:dsh -- C:\path\to\deepseek-harness
pnpm pack:inspect

The packed artifact contains only the manifest, profile patch, and user documentation.
